issues.detail: Both ASTs use the parameter one not only in the factors 1+lambda_1' and 1+lambda_2' of lambda_0 but also in the radicands 1-lambda_1^2 and 1-lambda_2^2. Its only anchor is line 111, and its role instead claims that one appears in the max function, whose structural constant is actually zero. This leaves two executable constant occurrences without the locator required by their source equations and adds one objectively false role statement. Change the role to cover the unit constant in lambda_0 and both lambda-prime definitions, and add lines 95 and 104 as anchors; keep line 111. The already-correct square_exponent and sqrt_exponent parameters need no change.

The assessment correctly rejects the unnormalized/sign-inconsistent threshold claims at lines 125 and 211 and selects equations supported by the reported 0.119 value. It does not record that supplementary prose at lines 366-367 also places turning points at nonsensical eta=+/-lambda_0 and states thresholds using log(lambda_0) without the required 2*pi, nor that line 227 says delocalization starts as soon as 2*pi*eta>0 immediately after stating localization persists while 2*pi*eta<L. The selected Eq. at line 402, the dual Eq. at line 359, and 0.119 at line 152 resolve these as prose errors; none is a selected claim locator. Explicitly quarantine all of them in the card assessment (or an unlinked resolved provenance note) so a later author cannot reintroduce the wrong threshold. Keep source_ambiguities empty only after this resolution is stated; do not alter either AST.

The numerical interval itself is source-supported: line 82 contains the 0.2 and 0.67 endpoints, lines 134 and 418 report whole/entire-parameter-space scans, and the model defines both couplings on [0,1]. However, the lambda_1 and lambda_2 control entries explicitly invoke the coupling meanings and 0-to-1 ranges while their anchors omit the direct definitions at lines 95 and 104. Likewise, the readout calls L an inverse localization length but anchors only average decay and Eq. 402, omitting the exact statement at line 218. Add lines 95 and 104 to the respective control locator chains and line 218 to the readout. Retain the existing endpoint/scan anchors and the current [0.2,0.67]^2 domain, which requires no scientific change.
